title: my-cloudflared-bin
subtitle: cloudflared Linux binary (40 MB) for Step2 quick tunnel
description: cloudflared-linux-amd64 (statically linked ELF, 40.2 MB) used by Step2 to publish the Ollama API via a cloudflare quick tunnel. Step2 restores bin/cloudflared from here to skip the 40 MB GitHub download on every run (single point of failure when GitHub is unreachable). Source: https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64
